# Introduction {#introduction}

*Introduction Text*

## Purpose {#purpose}

The purpose of this project is to replicate analysis done by the HEYA Research Group for natural disasters on points of interest across Canada.

## Required Information {#required-information}

### Datasets {#datasets}

This tutorial uses the following **publicly available** datasets:

| Data Provider | Dataset | Type |
|-----------------------|------------------------------|-------------------|
| Natural Resources Canada (CFS / CWFIS) | National Burned Area Composite (**NBAC**) wildfire perimeters (1972--2024) ([cwfis.cfs.nrcan.gc.ca](https://cwfis.cfs.nrcan.gc.ca/en/catalogue/results/537a1fd0-698e-4a7b-85a1-e02581ae78b2 "NBAC - Canadian Wildland Fire Information System")) | Polygon (vector) |
| Natural Resources Canada (EGS) | **Floods in Canada - Archive** (flood extent products) ([open.canada.ca](https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/74144824-206e-4cea-9fb9-72925a128189 "Floods in Canada - Archive - Open Government Portal")) | Polygon (vector) |
| Environment and Climate Change Canada | Historical climate observations & station metadata ([climate.weather.gc.ca](https://climate.weather.gc.ca/climate_data/bulk_data_e.html?format=csv&stationID=XXX&Year=2024&Month=1&Day=1&timeframe=2&submit=Download+Data%22 "Government of Canada Weather and Climate")) | Point (vector) |
| National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration - National Hurricane Center | NHC GIS Archive ([nhc.noaa.gov](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/gis/archive_besttrack.php?year= "NOAA Hurricane Best Tracks")) | Point & Polygon (vector) |
| Statistics Canada | Open Database of Hospital Facilities ([open.canada.ca](https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/a1bcd4ee-8e57-499b-9c6f-94f6902fdf32 "Open Canada")) | Point (vector) |

 

This tutorial also uses datasets with **access restrictions**. Access may require institutional access, and/or data-use agreements.

| Data Provider | Dataset | Access |
|-------------------|-----------------------------|------------------------|
| Statistics Canada | Postal Code Conversion File (**PCCF**) v7E | Licensed |
| Canadian Urban Environmental Health Research Consortium (CANUE) | Local Climate Zones & PM2.5 (smoke) by Postcode | Request via project creation in CANUE (free) |

### R packages {#r-packages}

The following R packages are required to run the code in this book:

**Data processing and wrangling**

-   `dplyr`
-   `tidyverse`
-   `tidyr`
-   `lubridate`
-   `data.table`
-   `tibble`
-   `readr`
-   `purrr`
-   `stringr`
-   `readxl`
-   `writexl`
-   `rvest`
-   `httr`
-   `fs`
-   `tm`
-   `SnowballC`
-   `proxy`
-   `cmdstanr`
-   `arrow`
-   `sfarrow`

**Data visualization and mapping**

-   `ggplot2`
-   `maps`
-   `knitr`
-   `kableExtra`
-   `terra`

**Spatial analysis**

-   `sf`
-   `geosphere`
-   `mapview`

**Data download**

-   `weathercan`

***Optional***

-   `furrr` (offers improved processing speeds)

The following code installs (if needed) and loads these packages:

```{r required-packages, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Vector of required packages
packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "lubridate", "data.table", "tibble",
  "readr", "purrr", "furrr", "stringr", "readxl", "writexl",
  "ggplot2", "maps", "rvest", "httr", "tm", "SnowballC", "proxy", "cmdstanr",
  "sf", "geosphere", "fs", "knitr", "kableExtra", "arrow", "sfarrow",
  "weathercan", "furrr", "tidyverse", "terra", "mapview"
)

# Install any that are missing
installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
to_install <- setdiff(packages, installed)
if (length(to_install) > 0) {
  install.packages(to_install)
}

# Load all packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

#configure mapview to use public imagery
mapviewOptions(basemaps = c("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas"))
```
